lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a structured grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of high-luminance blobs to create a localized grid-like lattice across the flank posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with specular highlights on the superior edges and defined shadows on the inferior edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible strictly within the lower and posterior portions of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several elongated, low-luminance biological attachments (remoras) are present on the lateral and dorsal surfaces; a small, high-luminance anomaly is visible at the distal trailing tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-density spotting on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and presence of multiple commensal teleost fish trailing and attached to the main body.
